QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_66

question.text: Performance reporting and benchmarking for Cat III AIFs is based on:

answer.text: Pre-tax Net Asset Value (NAV) of the Scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Box 6.2(g), reporting/benchmarking uses pre-tax NAV of the scheme. The Trap: Post-tax/GAV/PIC are different bases. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with other reporting standards (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Clarify to clients: benchmarked returns are pre-tax — apply individual tax after.
